pages.title: Incorythe MKII
pages.text: Not satisfied with your Incorythe MKI? Surround it with Incorythe Gems and diamonds to forge the Incorythe MKII. This refined blade deals 14.5 attack damage with a blazing attack speed of 2.2 and keeps the 3512 uses of its predecessor. Few blades strike as fast and as hard.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: An Incorythe MKI in the centre, diamonds on the sides and Incorythe Gems in the corners.
